label: D2 after a rare a1->S2 transition, in the last ~8 trials of the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO), and only when the agent chose a1 and was taken to S2 by a rare transition (99% of activation mass has in_action=a1 and in_state=S2). It is also tied to the end of the episode: all activity falls in episode trials 80-99 (99% in 90-99), and every activation sits in the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.22), which reflects the value head expecting the episode to end. Over all episodes, a1->S2 at D2 gives recall 0.96 but precision 0.05. Adding an ep_trial threshold gives dev F1 0.73 (>=90, mass recall 0.98) to 0.77 (>=92, recorded, mass recall 0.94). Swapping the threshold for value<5.22 gives a similar F1 (0.72). The strongest activations come from the core and later trials of windows near the very end, and typical examples follow a run of rewarded common a1->S1 trials while S1 is good. Requiring the previous trial to be rewarded did not help F1. It does not fire on a2->S1 rare transitions, common transitions, or any D1/GO step. All variables used are observed at D2, so no FUTURE variable is needed. Within the late-episode a1->S2 steps, precision is still only about 0.7, so part of what gates firing (likely exact closeness to the end and the value level) is not captured.
